A Dictionary of Urdu, Classical Hindi, and English. A Dictionary of Urdu, Classical Hindi, and English. Search for headword: 'mūṅg' 11 results Highlight text and press "t" to transliterate (devanagari script only) 1) منگا muṅgā
                        ( p. 1080 ) H منگا मुंगा muṅgā , s.m. (dialec.) = mūṅgā , q.v. 2) منگوس muṅgūs, maṅgūs
                        ( p. 1081 ) H منگوس मुंगूस muṅgūs , or मंगूस maṅgūs [prob. S. मङ्घूषः , rt. मङ्घ् 'to move rapidly'; cf. S. अङ्गूषः ], s.m. (dialec.) The Mongoose, or ichneumon, Viverra ichneumon (syn. newalā or neʼolā , the more com. form). 3) مونگ mūṅg
                        ( p. 1095 ) H مونگ मूंग mūṅg [Prk. मुग्गो ; S. मुट्गः ], s.m. A species of pulse, Phaseolus mung̠o : — mūṅg-phalī , s.f. The ground-nut, or pig-nut, of the West Indies, Arachis hypogœa : — mūṅg-kī phalī , The bean of Phaseolus mungo ; — (dialec.) Moringa pods: — mūṅg-kī dāl , Mūṅg -pulse, pulse of the mūṅg kind: — mūṅg-kī dāl khāne-wālā , s.m. One who lives on the pulse mūṅg (a contemptuous term for a Baniyā ). 4) مونگا mūṅgā
                        ( p. 1095 ) H مونگا मूंगा mūṅgā , s.m. (dialec.) The plant Hyperanthera moringa : — janglī mūṅgā , s.m. The wild Moringa, Hedysarum sennoides . 5) مونگا mūṅgā
                        ( p. 1095 ) H مونگا मूंगा mūṅgā [prob. Prk. मुगिअअं ; S. मृगित + कं , rt. मृग् 'to seek,' &c.], s.m. Coral, red coral. 6) مونگچي mūṅgćī
                        ( p. 1095 ) H مونگچي मूंगची mūṅgćī , s.f. = H مونگري मूंगरी mūṅgrī , s.f. = مونگوري mūṅgaurī , q.v. 7) مونگري mūṅgrī
                        ( p. 1095 ) H مونگري मूंगरी mūṅgrī , s.f. = H مونگچي मूंगची mūṅgćī , s.f. = مونگوري mūṅgaurī , q.v. 8) مونگوري mūṅgaurī
                        ( p. 1095 ) H مونگوري मूंगौरी mūṅgaurī [ mūṅg , q.v. + S. वट + इका ], s.f. A kind of dish made with mūṅg (syn. baṛī ; adaurī ). 9) مونگيا mūṅgiyā
                        ( p. 1095 ) H مونگيا मूंगिया mūṅgiyā [ mūṅg , q.v.+ iyā = Prk. इओ = S. इकः ], adj. Of the colour of mūṅg ; green. 10) مونگيا mūṅgiyā
                        ( p. 1095 ) H مونگيا मूंगिया mūṅgiyā (from mūṅgā , q.v.; - iyā , as in the preceding), adj. & s.m. Coral-coloured, of the colour of red coral; — coral-colour. 11) مونگير mūṅger
                        ( p. 1095 ) H مونگير मूंगेर mūṅger , adj. (dialec.) Headstrong, wilful, stubborn, obstinate. Search Form • DDSA Close

A Dictionary of Urdu, Classical Hindi, and English. A Dictionary of Urdu, Classical Hindi, and English. Search for headword: 'mewa' 4 results Highlight text and press "t" to transliterate (devanagari script only) 1) ميوا mewā
                        ( p. 1109 ) H ميوا मेवा mewā , s.m. corr. of ميوه mewa , q.v. 2) ميواتي mewātī, miwātī
                        ( p. 1109 ) H ميواتي मेवाती mewātī , or miwātī [ mewāt + ī = S. ईयः ], adj. & s.m. Of or belonging to the province of Mewāt; — the robber-tribe of Mewāt (i.q. mew ); a man of that tribe; — a native, or an inhabitant, of Mewāt. 3) ميوجات mewajāt
                        ( p. 1109 ) P ميوجات mewajāt ( mewa +A. pl. suff. āt , with euphon. change of silent h of ميوه into j ), s.m. pl. (of mewa ), Fruits. 4) ميوه mewa, mīwa
                        ( p. 1109 ) P ميوه mewa , or mīwa (old P. and Pehl. mīwa ), s.m. Fruit: — mewa-dār , vulg. mewe-dār , adj. Fruit-bearing, fruitful; laden with fruit: — mewa-farosh , s.m. Fruit-seller, fruiterer: — tar mewa , Fresh fruit: — ḵẖushk mewa , Dried fruit. Search Form • DDSA Close
